correctness.rationale: All maximal geodesics are 3-vertex L paths in diameter-two R_n. A full packing has n paths, one pivot and one wing in each column. This forces a fixed-point-free permutation of columns and an adjacent-distinct 3-row coloring; the inverse constructs a unique path per pivot, partitions vertices, and proves the bound sharp. Cycle-coloring counts 2^ell+2(-1)^ell and exponential permutation formula gives exact EGF, with verified partial fractions. Independently implemented BFS, exact-cover search and permutation enumeration match every cycle-count coefficient for n=2..7 (total 6,12,216,1440,22320,272160); no finite test is treated as a proof.

originality.rationale: The 2022 primary paper only bounds the rook-graph packing number and solves a different transversal problem. OEIS A137946 entirely covers the coefficient sequence/EGF, acknowledged and excluded from novelty. The surviving claim is an explicit graph-geodesic bijection for perfect rook-graph packing; its inverse and uniqueness do not follow as statements from the numerical OEIS formula alone. Full relevant primary text and source/table were inspected, and accessible research searches found no matching graph-geodesic interpretation. Remaining possibility of an older equivalent perfect P3 decomposition is a genuine priority risk.
residual_risks: OEIS A137946 already contains the full numerical triangle and equivalent analytic EGF; only the graph-geodesic interpretation may be original.
Previously published perfect induced P3 packings or rook-tiling bijections under alternate terminology may cover the same classification.
Search coverage, including published-finding corpus, cannot establish a universal absence of prior work.
